texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Create compact links, manage expiration, and view privacy-friendly visit statistics.
texts.Feature:Manage:Description: Choose a custom code, set expiration, disable links, and generate QR codes.
texts.Feature:Measure:Description: See daily trends, referrer domains, browsers, and devices without storing raw IP addresses.
texts.Feature:Protect:Description: Email confirmation, quotas, rate limits, target validation, and administrator controls are included.
texts.EmailConfirmation:Subject: Confirm your ShortLink email address
texts.EmailConfirmation:Instructions: Confirm your email address before signing in and creating short links.
texts.EmailConfirmation:Expiry: This confirmation link expires in two hours.
texts.EmailConfirmationSent:Title: Check your email
texts.EmailConfirmationSent:Description: If registration succeeded, a confirmation link was sent to {0}.
texts.ConfirmEmail:SuccessDescription: Your email address is confirmed. You can now sign in.
texts.ConfirmEmail:FailureDescription: The link is invalid or expired. Request a new confirmation email.
texts.ResendConfirmation:GenericResult: If an unconfirmed account exists for this address, a new confirmation email has been sent.
